info.title: PiStorm64 Control API
info.summary: Control plane API for PiStorm64 system, storage, SCSI, A314, and runtime configuration
info.description:
Complete API contract for phone/web control of PiStorm64 features including kickstart profile selection, PiSCSI unit management (disk/cdrom/remote/block), A314 drive slots (pi0:/pd0:..pd4:), runtime setvar/config editing, and reset operations.

Compatibility routes under /api/* and /ws are included for phone/web UI scaffolding. Canonical management operations remain under /api/v1/*.
